data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 0094852dcac7 abstracts SRC_005 and SRC_002 jointly: it is a higher-level causal account of how a content-edit hole in the code survived review because the ledger recorded decisions without recording the code diff, so it is refuted if the isolated node mentions no gap between recorded decision text and actual code content that SRC_002 and SRC_005 could jointly expose.
